title: 更新 POST /api/enroll 接受多時段 scheduleIds
content:
EnrollmentWizard 目前送出 scheduleId (單一)，需改為接受 scheduleIds (字串陣列)。

變更範圍：
1. Zod schema enroll.ts: scheduleId → scheduleIds (z.array(z.string()).min(1))
2. route.ts 交易：改為對每個 scheduleId 檢查 quotaRemaining > 0 並遞減
3. 建立 RegistrantSchedule 關聯紀錄
4. 仍保留單一 scheduleId 的向下相容（可選）

[待確認] 若多個時段中有一個 quota 不足，要全部拒絕還是部分接受？

findings: All scheduleIds validated — rejects on missing/inactive schedule
All-or-nothing quota check — if any schedule lacks seats, all rejected
RegistrantSchedule links created for each (registrant × scheduleId) pair
Atomic transaction: all schedules decremented or none
evidence.residual: Partial-accept behavior (accept available seats, reject full ones) not implemented — need user decision.

acceptance: Atomic transaction: all slots decremented or none
RegistrantSchedule records created for each scheduleId
Error response when one or more schedules have insufficient quota
verification: curl POST /api/enroll with 2 scheduleIds → 201 + RegistrantSchedule created. curl with full schedule → 400.
